descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Graffiti 4 is a spray painting sandbox in virtual reality. One enormous hall, and every wall in it is yours.

THE PAINT WAREHOUSE
A 30 by 60 metre legal paint hall in an old factory, under a sawtooth glass roof that pours sun across the floor all day. Red brick bays down one side, painted concrete bays down the other, three free standing walls you can paint on both faces, and a huge hero wall at the far end. 19 paintable walls in all.

BUILT FROM REAL SURFACES
Every wall, column and floor is a real photographed material. Paint soaks into the brick so every mortar line still reads through your piece, and fresh spray catches the window light.

MIDDAY OR GOLDEN HOUR
One button on the menu drops the sun, floods the hall with warm light and turns the high bay lamps on. Paint the same wall at both times of day and it is a different picture.

REAL SPRAY PAINT FEEL
The spray gets wider the further you stand back. Hold the can still up close and the paint runs. Shake a can to hear it rattle.

STENCILS A TO Z
A board of 26 letter stencils plus stars, crowns, bolts, hearts, arrows and NYC. Stick one flat on any wall, spray over it and peel it off.

YOUR TOOLS
- 8 spray cans and a full colour wheel
- Skinny, medium and fat caps
- Take a photo of your wall, saved on your headset
- Clean one wall or every wall with a fresh coat
- Six music tracks

Graffiti 4 is a single player, standing experience with smooth walking and snap turning. No account and no internet needed.
